title: ImGui renders SDR sRGB colours with an 8-bit UNORM pipeline into an HDR10 (PQ, BT.2020) back buffer
expected_finding: fsMain writes sRGB-encoded BT.709 ImGui colours unchanged into the A2B10G10R10 / HDR10_ST2084 swapchain, which expects PQ-encoded BT.2020 values (no sRGB decode, primaries conversion or PQ encode); the ImGui pipeline is also built for R8G8B8A8_UNORM instead of the back buffer's format
